name: Gold After the News
plain_words: On CPI, FOMC and payroll days, trade gold in the direction of the first 30 minutes after the release, stop at the other side of that 30-minute move, out after two more sessions. Micro gold futures cost.

data.bars: Dukascopy XAUUSD 5-min (2022→ in the vault; 2012-22 lives in the lab's golddata/)

cost.note: MGC $1.92 round turn + 1 tick ($1.00) per side

firm.name: futures prop account (Topstep-style 50K)
firm.note: daily loss = self-imposed $1,000; max loss = $2,000 trailing end-of-day; flat before 16:10 ET

pass_line.note: tightened 2026-09-14 before any verdict was adopted: 'sized so the firm's rules hold' is evaluated as the LARGEST risk per trade at which they hold, and the strategy must earn >= 10%/yr of the account at that size — an edge that only survives at a size that earns nothing is not a pass

expectation: Real but rare (about 30 trades a year): cannot reach 200 out-of-sample trades before ~2030 on 2022→ data — most likely INSUFFICIENT; may only qualify as a sizing overlay.
